methods.label: Conditional component comparison and counterexample
methods.explanation:
If \(m\) and \(n\) are real, \(0=0+0i\), so the real part satisfies \(m+1=0\), giving \(m=-1\).

The question does not specify that \(m\) and \(n\) are real, so the displayed coefficients cannot generally be treated as real and imaginary parts. If complex values are permitted, \((m,n)=(-1,1)\) satisfies the equation, but so does \((m,n)=(0,1+i)\), since
\[
(0+1)+((1+i)-1)i=1+i^2=0.
\]
Thus the keyed value is \(m=-1\) under the real-number assumption, while the question as written has no unique answer.
